guard: the session journal records the requested model pin after setModel, not the harness default

MCP spawn of w972 recorded deepseek-v4-pro despite grok-4.6. Skipping setModel leaves that
default in the journal while the spawn still succeeds.

mutations.name: A1 skip setModel so the journal keeps the harness default
mutations.expectRed: session journal records the requested model pin, not the harness default

mutations.name: A2 do not map a recovered journal fold into its terminal event
